title: Uruguayan Cheesy Wicked Fries
description: A vegan twist on the classic cheesy fries, made with wicked and uruguayan flavors.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Spread the fries out in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle the fries with a little bit of oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake the fries in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy.
While the fries are baking, mix together the wicked vegan cheese shreds, malted vinegar, uruguayan chimichurri, chili powder, and garlic powder in a bowl.
Once the fries are done, remove them from the oven and toss them in the cheese mixture until evenly coated.
Serve the cheesy fries hot and enjoy!
